pr_title: Making classname optional in Transport protocol
pr_body:
Classname (the plugin entry point) is not needed for Stable plugins, but current code for transport protocol deserialization/serialization requires a classname to be present.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/98584
pr_comments: Hi @ldematte, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Hi @ldematte, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: Stable plugins have null `org.elasticsearch.plugins.PluginDescriptor#classname` which causes NPEs
issue_context.body:
We pass `null` for the class name here:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/f086dd18ddc705bf84a1ff99d35196ec2498fd52/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/plugins/PluginDescriptor.java#L261

However the class name is mandatory for the transport protocol today:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/f086dd18ddc705bf84a1ff99d35196ec2498fd52/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/plugins/PluginDescriptor.java#L156

This prevents various APIs from working in a cluster with stable plugins installed.
comments: So how to solve this bug? From 2022.7, stable plugin has no 'classname' field.  Should it adjust serialize 'classname' as optional string when it's writing into stream, then read optionally from streeam ? Or forcing stable plugin to have 'classfield'?
